# Security Policy

The Tellurian nix-terminal maintainers take the security of our users seriously.
Please follow the guidelines below when reporting suspected vulnerabilities.

## Supported versions

Only the latest `main` branch and the most recent published release (if any)
receive security fixes. Older tags are considered out of support.

## Reporting a vulnerability

1. **Do not open a public issue.** Instead, create a
   [Private Vulnerability Report](https://docs.github.com/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
   in this repository.
2. If the GitHub reporting feature is unavailable, email
   `security@tellurian.dev` with the following details:
   - A clear description of the vulnerability and the affected component.
   - Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept code.
   - Any potential impact or suggested mitigations.
3. Expect an acknowledgement within *5 business days*. If you have not heard
   back, please follow up on the same thread.

## After you report

- Maintainers will confirm the issue, assess severity, and develop a fix.
- You will be kept informed about progress and timelines.
- Once a patch is ready, we will coordinate disclosure and attribution if you
  wish to be credited.

Thanks for helping keep Tellurian nix-terminal and its users safe.
